acceptanceCriteria: The enrollment format carries the artifact bytes, or a content-addressed reference, for cem/1.0 capsules
The closure admits a capsule built in another worktree; a test proves it
body: Found by the V1-0632 gap 1 lane (PR #1287). A capsule enrollment for a cem/1.0 map names its artifacts by digest, but the enrollment format cannot carry the artifact bytes, so a capsule built elsewhere cannot be closed without the producing worktree. Expected: an enrollment either carries the bounded artifact bytes or names a content-addressed source the closure can read. Actual: the closure needs the artifacts present locally.
title: local-authority enrollment format does not carry artifact bytes for stable CEM capsules
